Integration

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.app(monkeypatch)

Create a Flask application configured for integration testing.

The application’s UPDATE_FUNCTION is replaced with a no-op because the analysis page calculates its results directly from the PostgreSQL data during rendering.

Parameters:

monkeypatch – Pytest fixture used to replace UPDATE_FUNCTION.

Returns:

A Flask test application.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.clean_data_file(tmp_path, monkeypatch)

Create an empty applicant-data file in an isolated temporary directory.

The current working directory is changed to the temporary directory so that file paths used by the application remain isolated from the real project data.

Parameters:

  • tmp_path – Pytest fixture providing a temporary directory.

  • monkeypatch – Pytest fixture used to change the working directory.

Returns:

Path to the temporary applicant-data JSON file.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.client(app)

Create a Flask test client for the integration test application.

Parameters:

app – Flask application fixture.

Returns:

A Flask test client.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.db_connection()

Connect to the PostgreSQL database used by the application.

The connection string is taken from load_data.DATABASE_URL when configured. Otherwise, the individual database connection settings from load_data are used.

Returns:

A PostgreSQL connection available to the test.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.test_best_match_branches()

Verify the empty-input, no-match, and exact-match branches.

The test confirms that _best_match returns None when either input is empty or no candidate meets the cutoff, and returns the exact candidate when a valid match is found.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.test_call_llm_invalid_json_and_no_normalization(monkeypatch)

Verify that invalid LLM JSON falls back to the original input values.

Normalization is disabled for both fields, so the original program and university values should be returned when the LLM response cannot be parsed as valid JSON.

Parameters:

monkeypatch – Pytest fixture used to replace the LLM loader.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.test_call_llm_json_object_with_normalization(monkeypatch)

Verify that parsed LLM output is normalized against canonical values.

The fake LLM returns an embedded JSON object containing abbreviated or non-canonical values. The test verifies that the returned values are normalized to the configured canonical program and university names.

Parameters:

monkeypatch – Pytest fixture used to replace the LLM loader and canonical value lists.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.test_canonical_match_branches()

Verify canonical matching for empty, missing, and normalized inputs.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.test_cli_process_file_closes_sink_on_error(monkeypatch, tmp_path)

Verify that CLI processing leaves the output file available after an error.

The LLM call is forced to raise an exception. The test verifies that the exception propagates while the output file has still been created.

Parameters:

  • monkeypatch – Pytest fixture used to replace the LLM call.

  • tmp_path – Pytest fixture providing temporary input and output paths.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.test_cli_process_file_default_output_path(monkeypatch, tmp_path)

Verify that CLI processing derives the default JSONL output path.

Parameters:

  • monkeypatch – Pytest fixture used to replace the LLM call.

  • tmp_path – Pytest fixture providing the temporary input directory.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.test_cli_process_file_to_stdout(monkeypatch, tmp_path, capsys)

Verify that CLI file processing writes standardized records to stdout.

Parameters:

  • monkeypatch – Pytest fixture used to replace the LLM call.

  • tmp_path – Pytest fixture providing a temporary directory.

  • capsys – Pytest fixture used to capture standard output.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.test_cli_process_file_writes_and_appends(monkeypatch, tmp_path)

Verify that CLI file processing writes and appends JSONL output.

The first invocation creates the output file and writes one record. The second invocation uses append mode and verifies that the file then contains two records.

Parameters:

  • monkeypatch – Pytest fixture used to replace the LLM call.

  • tmp_path – Pytest fixture providing temporary input and output paths.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.test_end_to_end_pull_update_render(client, monkeypatch, db_connection, clean_data_file)

Verify the complete data-pull, cleaning, database, and analysis flow.

The test replaces the real scraper with a fake scraper that supplies multiple applicant records. It then verifies that the records pass through the background pull process into PostgreSQL, that the analysis update succeeds, and that the rendered analysis contains the expected calculated values.

Parameters:

  • client – Flask test client used to exercise application routes.

  • monkeypatch – Pytest fixture used to replace the real scraper.

  • db_connection – PostgreSQL connection used to inspect and restore database contents.

  • clean_data_file – Temporary JSON file used by the fake scraper.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.test_health_endpoint()

Verify that the LLM service health endpoint returns a successful response.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.test_load_data_clean_float_none()

Verify that cleaning a None numeric value returns None.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.test_load_data_invalid_p_id()

Verify that a record with a non-numeric result ID is rejected.

The test supplies a result URL whose identifier is not numeric and verifies that _transform_record returns None.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.test_load_llm_cached(monkeypatch)

Verify that an already-loaded LLM instance is returned unchanged.

Parameters:

monkeypatch – Pytest fixture used to provide the cached LLM object.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.test_load_llm_initializes(monkeypatch)

Verify that the LLM is initialized with the configured model settings.

The model download and Llama constructor are replaced with test doubles. The test confirms that the downloaded model path and configured context, thread, GPU-layer, and verbosity settings are passed to the constructor.

Parameters:

monkeypatch – Pytest fixture used to replace model-loading dependencies.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.test_main_file_entrypoint(monkeypatch, tmp_path)

Verify the --file CLI entry point passes the expected arguments.

The file-processing function is replaced with a test double so that the test can verify the parsed input path, output path, append flag, and stdout flag without performing actual LLM processing.

Parameters:

  • monkeypatch – Pytest fixture used to replace the file processor and configure command-line arguments.

  • tmp_path – Pytest fixture providing temporary input and output paths.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.test_main_serve_entrypoint(monkeypatch)

Verify the --serve CLI entry point starts Flask with the expected settings.

Parameters:

monkeypatch – Pytest fixture used to replace app.run, modify command-line arguments, and configure the port environment variable.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.test_multiple_pulls_are_idempotent_for_overlapping_data(client, db_connection, monkeypatch, clean_data_file)

Verify that overlapping pulls do not create duplicate applicants.

The first pull inserts two applicants. The second pull contains one applicant with an existing p_id and one new applicant. The test verifies that the existing applicant is updated, the new applicant is inserted, and the total row count is three.

Parameters:

  • client – Flask test client used to exercise the pull endpoint.

  • db_connection – PostgreSQL connection used to inspect and restore database contents.

  • monkeypatch – Pytest fixture used to replace the real scraper.

  • clean_data_file – Temporary JSON file used by the fake scraper.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.test_normalize_input_branches()

Verify supported input shapes and invalid-input handling.

The test confirms that lists are returned unchanged, dictionaries with a list under rows are unwrapped, and invalid rows values or None result in an empty list.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.test_post_normalize_program_branches(monkeypatch)

Verify program normalization across canonical and fuzzy matches.

Parameters:

monkeypatch – Pytest fixture used to provide a controlled canonical program list.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.test_post_normalize_university_branches(monkeypatch)

Verify university normalization across matching and fallback cases.

The test covers fuzzy abbreviations, misspellings, whitespace and case normalization, canonical values, unknown universities, and an empty input.

Parameters:

monkeypatch – Pytest fixture used to provide a controlled canonical university list.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.test_read_lines_missing_file()

Verify that reading a missing file returns an empty list.

tests.test_integration_end_to_end.test_standardize_endpoint(monkeypatch)

Verify standardization behavior for known and unknown input values.

Known canonical values should disable normalization when passed to the LLM, while unknown values should request normalization for both the program and university.

Parameters:

monkeypatch – Pytest fixture used to replace the LLM call and canonical value lists.
